description: This Java class implements a custom field match validator used for validating that two specified fields on a Java object are equal, typically for form validation scenarios.

classes.name: FieldMatchValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if two fields on an object are equal, used for custom validation annotations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the annotation's specified field names and creates a BeanUtils instance.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the two specified fields on the given object have equal values, handling nulls and exceptions.
